rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a toothed cutting tool.

example.english: I bought a saw to take home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 baa2 geoi3 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for cutting with a saw and for making a similar back-and-forth motion.

example.english: I know how to saw wooden boards.
